title: Chinese civilian and military studies show a growing concern that US AI advances may cut nuclear decision-making to 90 seconds, undermining Beijing's deterrent (Chris Buckley/New York Times)
summary: Chris Buckley / New York Times: Chinese civilian and military studies show a growing concern that US AI advances may cut nuclear decision-making to 90 seconds, undermining Beijing's deterrent — Chinese military researchers are studying how to harness A.I., but they worry the technology makes their country's nuclear forces more vulnerable to attack.
